versions.changelog:
super-stock-analysis v1.0.0

- Initial release of super-stock-analysis.
- Analyze stocks and cryptocurrencies using Yahoo Finance data.
- Features include portfolio management, customizable watchlists with alerts, and dividend analysis.
- Provides 8-dimension stock scoring, trend detection (Hot Scanner), and rumor/signal early detection.
- Supports stock analysis, portfolio tracking, earnings reaction monitoring, crypto market analysis, and finding emerging rumors and trends.
